def min_swaps_to_transform(n, p, s):
    from collections import defaultdict

    # Create a mapping from value to its position in both permutations
    pos_p = defaultdict(list)
    pos_s = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n):
        pos_p[p[i]].append(i)
        pos_s[s[i]].append(i)

    # Check if the two permutations have the same set of values at the same positions
    if pos_p != pos_s:
        return -1

    # Initialize the minimum number of coins needed
    min_coins = float('inf')
    best_operations = []

    # Try all possible swaps
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            # Swap p[i] and p[j]
            p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
            # Check if we have reached the target permutation s
            if p == s:
                # Calculate the number of coins needed
                coins = abs(i - j)
                if coins < min_coins:
                    min_coins = coins
                    best_operations = [[i + 1, j + 1]]
                elif coins == min_coins:
                    best_operations.append([i + 1, j + 1])
            # Swap back p[i] and p[j]
            p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]

    return min_coins, best_operations
